cards.title: OpenAI Acquires Travel Startup Odessia
cards.body: OpenAI has acquired Odessia, a travel startup founded by Sonder's Francis Davidson. The company hasn't disclosed its plans for the acquisition yet.

cards.title: New York Enforces AI Safety Law
cards.body: New York's sweeping AI safety law now requires major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register and disclose safety practices. Companies must report critical incidents or face fines.

cards.title: Anthropic Founders to Pocket $250M Each
cards.body: All seven Anthropic co-founders plan to sell equal shares in the IPO, netting about $250 million each at midpoint. The group maintains company control after the offering.

cards.title: Oura Acquires AI Healthcare Startup Counsel
cards.body: Oura is acquiring AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625 million. The deal follows Oura's indefinite postponement of its $2.2 billion IPO.

cards.title: PSI Advances Quantum Computing with AI
cards.body: PSI used an unreleased Anthropic model to solve a fundamental quantum computing question scientists pursued for nearly two decades. The breakthrough demonstrates AI's potential for scientific discovery.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches Business Profiles for ChatGPT
cards.body: OpenAI rolled out new business profiles to make ChatGPT a more robust consumer discovery engine. Features empower businesses to enhance their presence on the platform.

cards.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Meetings Feature
cards.body: Claude Meetings turns workplace discussions into plans and tasks in real-time. The tool can draft plans, create timelines, answer questions, and access connected work apps.

cards.title: Google Releases Two New AI Chips
cards.body: Google launched new tensor processing units (TPUs) for confidential model training and increased memory capacity. The expansion broadens its chip portfolio across more use cases.

cards.title: Meta's AI Assistant Reaches Smartwatches
cards.body: Meta's AI agent Muse is now available on Apple Watch and Android Wear OS. Users can interact via voice calls, text messages, and dictation.

cards.title: Adobe Brings AI Agents to Creative Suite
cards.body: Adobe introduced AI agents and new creative tools across Photoshop, Premiere, and Firefly. A new prototype builder tool takes on Figma's design capabilities.

cards.title: Anthropic Sets IPO Price Range at $70-78
cards.body: Anthropic set its IPO price range at $70 to $78 per share, implying a $1.404 trillion valuation. The company could reach peak valuation if shares list at top of range.

cards.title: New OS Kora Challenges Windows for AI
cards.body: Cyanogen's co-founder is launching Kora, a free-to-use alternative to Windows targeting AI-heavy users. The OS is designed for an AI-first computing era.

cards.title: Spotify AI DJ Gets New Voices
cards.body: Spotify Premium users can now customize their AI DJ with new voices and personalities. Users can also disable commentary between songs for quieter listening.

cards.title: Amazon Ring Launches Security Drone
cards.body: Ring announced a home security drone and enterprise security robot for consumer and business markets. Amazon is pushing Ring deeper into robotics and surveillance.

cards.title: Cyberattacks Threaten Open Source AI
cards.body: Hugging Face executive warns that growing cyberattacks on open AI platforms could force tighter security restrictions. The threat could undermine open source accessibility and developer collaboration.

cards.title: Otter AI Supports 30+ Languages
cards.body: Otter AI added support for 27 languages with an upcoming feature for multilingual conversations. The platform can follow along when speakers switch between languages.

cards.title: Anthropic Moves Forward with IPO Plans
cards.body: Anthropic is expected to set its IPO valuation range this week. The company continues preparations for its public market debut.

cards.title: Nvidia CEO Engaged PR Firm Year Ago
cards.body: Jensen Huang reportedly hired a PR firm specializing in high-profile sex scandals a year before his own scandal erupted. The firm was enlisted after October 2025 reporting on his business dealings.

cards.title: Short Seller Flagged Nvidia CEO Ties
cards.body: Culper Research questioned Jensen Huang's ties to a suspected Chinese executive six months before the scandal went public. The short seller had raised concerns about the unusually close relationship.

cards.title: Pelosi's Successor Targets AI and Data Centers
cards.body: California state senator Scott Wiener, who authored AI regulation legislation, won Nancy Pelosi's congressional seat and could shape federal AI policy. He's positioned to play a key role in setting new guardrails for advanced AI development.

cards.title: Data Center Power Crunch Overshadows AI Boom
cards.body: The backlash against data center expansion isn't really about the facilities themselves—it's fundamentally about electricity demand. As AI infrastructure grows, power grid capacity has become the critical constraint limiting expansion.

cards.title: Nancy Pelosi's Replacement Ready to Regulate AI
cards.body: Scott Wiener authored legislation to curb advanced AI risks while serving as a California state senator. Now in Congress, he could play a pivotal role in shaping federal AI policy and oversight.

cards.title: Climate Case for AI Remains Unproven
cards.body: As the UN climate conference convenes, the promised environmental benefits of AI are being questioned by experts. The case that AI supports climate goals has not yet been substantively made.

cards.title: Humanoid Robot Cleaning Service Arrives in SF
cards.body: A new humanoid robot cleaning service is now operating in San Francisco, offering a glimpse into future automation. The technology demonstrates practical near-term applications of robotics and AI in everyday services.

cards.title: Texas AI Data Center Boom Faces Uncertainty
cards.body: Texas became the fastest-growing US data center market but faces potential setbacks from energy policy shifts. The state's AI infrastructure expansion plans may be disrupted by changing regulatory landscape.

cards.title: Grok Build AI Leaks Confidential Information
cards.body: xAI's Grok Build coding agent exposed significant confidential data, including materials belonging to SpaceX. The security breach highlights risks in AI development tools handling sensitive company information.

cards.title: Mathematics Transforms When AI Becomes Oracle
cards.body: AI's role in mathematical discovery is reshaping how mathematicians work and think about their field. The technology fundamentally changes what's possible in mathematical research and problem-solving.

cards.title: DeepMind Releases Gemini Robotics and Safety Benchmark
cards.body: DeepMind unveiled Gemini Robotics 2.5 alongside an open safety benchmark called ASIMOV-jailbreak. The releases advance both AI robotics capabilities and standardized safety evaluation methods.

cards.title: Nvidia Faces Jensen Huang Succession Challenge
cards.body: Nvidia confronts a critical leadership question as CEO Jensen Huang has no obvious successor identified. The AI chip leader's future governance structure remains unclear amid explosive growth.

cards.title: Ukraine's Fiber Drones Squeezed by AI Demand
cards.body: AI data center expansion is consuming fiber-optic resources that Ukraine's drone programs depend on. The competition for critical infrastructure highlights competing demands in AI infrastructure buildout.
